bullets.text: In Ponneri, contract worker families staged a protest at the Kattupalli desalination plant demanding compensation after an accident, and the office should monitor relief measures.
Residents in Gummidipoondi blocked national highways following a four-hour power outage, and the office should coordinate with the electricity board to address local outages.
Residents on OMR and Radial Road faced drinking water shortages as a 98 crore project stalled, and the office should ensure the board resumes pipeline laying.
Greater Chennai Traffic Police announced vehicle diversions for Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit, and the office should watch traffic movement in the constituency.
Police registered a case and arrested a couple for a theft at a doctor's house, and the office should track the ongoing police investigation.
Farmer Poobalan died by suicide due to stomach ailments in Tiruttani, and the office should verify if his family receives eligible welfare assistance.
Ponneri residents faced infrastructure hardships and delayed work orders, and the office should expedite approvals for tendered municipal projects.
Avadi residents faced traffic bottlenecks due to Metro Water works on East Gopalapuram road, and the office should ensure faster completion of pipeline tasks.
Tamil Nadu continues attracting global capability centers while facing competition from Bengaluru's AI city plans, and the office should promote state tech policies.
Tamil Nadu ranks among states with high worker exposure where AI improves productivity, and the office should support workforce digital readiness programs.
Suzlon announced investments in AI-powered blade factories including in Tamil Nadu, and the office should track job creation commitments for 2027.
Youth and activists staged protests in Chennai demanding the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, and the office should monitor public demonstrations.
AIADMK leader Edappadi K. Palaniswami criticized government claims regarding metro rail projects, and the office should prepare responses to political allegations.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay and Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Chennai Metro Phase II stretch, and the office should track new transit operations.
Chief Minister Vijay urged the Centre to approve Metro Phase III and education funds, and the office should follow up on central project clearances.
